title: RAG groundedness + refusal
description: The hallucination test. Given a short context, the model must answer only from it - and must visibly refuse when the answer simply is not there. Cheap models often invent a plausible answer instead of refusing.
system: Answer strictly and only from the CONTEXT provided. If the context does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know based on the provided context. Never use outside knowledge.

cases.context: The Zephyr X200 router supports Wi-Fi 6E and ships with a 3-year warranty. It has 4 gigabit LAN ports. Firmware updates are delivered quarterly.
cases.input: How many LAN ports does the Zephyr X200 have?
